audit.notes: Extremely reusable format. It relies entirely on 1-second cuts of relatable daily lifestyle footage (working, morning routine, resting, walking outside, city views, reading). The library contains ample footage covering every concept.
audit.summary: A fast-paced montage of calm, aesthetic lifestyle b-roll clips paired with text lines highlighting mature personal habits labeled as 'silent flexes in life'.
